Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes This PR uses engine-aware JSON mutation when cron runtime updates enable or disable a job. **Example:** A PostgreSQL-backed one-shot job named one-shot finishes successfully with deleteAfterRun: false. - **Before:** Finalization calls SQLite json_set, fails with PostgreSQL error 42883, and leaves the job marked as running. - **After:** Finalization records the successful result and stores enabled: false while retaining the job's authored configuration. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | The focused patch is correct on inspection and has meaningful cross-engine regression coverage; the supplied after-fix evidence remains at the in-process boundary. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | The maintainer-authored PR is outside the ordinary contributor proof gate; supplied evidence reports a real-Gateway failure and passing owner-level regressions, while final-head live scheduled execution remains pending. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** A successfully executed retained one-shot remains marked as running because PostgreSQL rejects its finalization statement. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored repair restores existing behavior through the established engine abstraction without adding settings or changing product policy. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** This PR fixes a concrete PostgreSQL failure still present on current main, preserves the existing cron storage contract, and introduces no actionable correctness findings. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `14193c8663ce803eaa5a478624be6c90b8131a6f` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None. ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: Final-head scheduled execution through a real PostgreSQL-backed Gateway is described as pending, with no after-fix runtime trace supplied.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Cron execution outcomes enter the existing transactional finalization worker, which updates job runtime state and run history through the shared row codec and database-engine SQL helpers. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Cron execution outcome] --> B[Finalization worker] B --> C[Runtime row mutation] C --> D[Cron row codec] D --> E[Engine JSON helper] E --> F[SQLite or PostgreSQL] B --> G[Run history] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Retain the focused helper substitution and its cross-engine finalization regression. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main source directly exposes the SQLite-only call during retained one-shot finalization, matching the reported PostgreSQL 42883 failure; this read-only review ran no target code. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The patch is the smallest complete repair: reuse the existing dialect owner while preserving the transaction, enablement policy, and authored fields. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [6cc605dfe204](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6cc605dfe2044a2d2649dea02458e7982739d493). ### Provenance checked - `Runtime enablement mutation` keeps the original intent (d89da7595d0d6c51f4e17b5631114023e49f931b: Preserve authored cron definitions during runtime changes and leave legacy normalization to backed-up Doctor repairs.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Verified introduced change:** The pinned introduction replaces the SQLite-only JSON mutation with the existing jsonSetPath helper and supplies its JSON-value flag. ([`src/cron/store/row-codec.ts:660`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/14193c8663ce803eaa5a478624be6c90b8131a6f/src/cron/store/row-codec.ts#L660), [14193c8663ce](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/14193c8663ce803eaa5a478624be6c90b8131a6f)) - **Current-main defect remains:** Current main still invokes json_set when previousEnabled differs from the completed job's enablement. ([`src/cron/store/row-codec.ts:659`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/6cc605dfe2044a2d2649dea02458e7982739d493/src/cron/store/row-codec.ts#L659), [6cc605dfe204](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6cc605dfe2044a2d2649dea02458e7982739d493)) - **Existing engine owner:** jsonSetPath preserves SQLite's JSON expression and emits PostgreSQL jsonb_set with JSON-valued replacement and text output. ([`src/infra/database-engine/json-values.ts:199`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/14193c8663ce803eaa5a478624be6c90b8131a6f/src/infra/database-engine/json-values.ts#L199), [14193c8663ce](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/14193c8663ce803eaa5a478624be6c90b8131a6f)) - **Transactional regression coverage:** The added test exercises the real finalization owner on both engines, checking terminal history, boolean disablement, retained custom configuration, and subsequent reenabling; PostgreSQL requires the configured conformance connection. ([`src/infra/database-engine/cron-runtime-row.postgres.test.ts:26`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/14193c8663ce803eaa5a478624be6c90b8131a6f/src/infra/database-engine/cron-runtime-row.postgres.test.ts#L26), [14193c8663ce](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/14193c8663ce803eaa5a478624be6c90b8131a6f)) - **Preserved historical intent:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/160448 introduced the narrow enablement mutation to preserve authored definitions and keep legacy repairs with Doctor; this PR retains that boundary. ([`src/cron/store/row-codec.ts:641`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d89da7595d0d6c51f4e17b5631114023e49f931b/src/cron/store/row-codec.ts#L641), [d89da7595d0d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d89da7595d0d6c51f4e17b5631114023e49f931b)) - **Discussion and validation status:** The complete body and comments contain a reported real-Gateway reproduction and passing database regressions, but describe final-head live execution as pending; PostgreSQL conformance checks were also still running. ([14193c8663ce](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/14193c8663ce803eaa5a478624be6c90b8131a6f)) ### PR surface Source +3, Tests +148. Total +151 across 2 files. Added test files: 1.
